response.sql: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM invoice_counts), compared AS (SELECT invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invoice_count), 0) AS total_number_of_invoices, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share

assumptions.assumption: If there are no invoices, shares are undefined; no orders qualify, so the result is 0 invoices and NULL for both averages.
